name: Summit AZ - Case Study Scrapbook
body:
> Report · Summit Az · 2026-10-09

# Summary
A living evidence log for an eventual Summit AZ SEO case study, started Sep 23, 2026 and backfilled from Sep 1. Status: COLLECTING, not ready to publish. Screenshots go in `case-study/shots/` (owned by the work-folders note). The SOP was adapted: Search Atlas replaces SEMrush, GSC web UI only, monthly routine on the 1st (first run Oct 1).

# Readiness gate
1. A full "after" window starting Oct 1 or later.
2. Clean GA4 organic key events for that window (not yet verified).
3. At least one organic CRM lead that became a booked job (0 booked as of Sep 16).
4. Scott approves the case study as a public asset.

# Baselines
- Pre-redesign (locked): Aug 7 to Sep 3, 37 clicks, 10,280 impressions, CTR 0.36%, position 26.0, non-branded clicks about 0. See [Summit AZ - Pre-Redesign Baseline 2026-09-03](lib:brain-summit-az-pre-redesign-baseline-2026-09-03).
- Keyword visibility: DA 6, about 23 real referring domains, rank tracker 84536 with 71 keywords.
- Technical baseline Sep 10: 336 missing alts, 4 orphan pages, 32 long titles, 111 bloated Rank Math keyword lists.
- Growth-phase starting line (Sep 24, label confirmed by Kim): Site Audit score 906 over 194 pages, 56 of 71 tracked keywords not ranking, GSC indexed 186 / not indexed 57 (only 25 worth working), home mobile PSI 38. Map grids: "emergency plumbing services" avg 4.6 with 13 of 39 pins top 3; "plumber mesa az" avg 12.7 with 0 pins top 3 (do not quote as a win).

# Execution log highlights
- Sep 5 to 15 Rank Math rebuild across 200 pages; Sep 10 to 11 technical sweep; Sep 12 hero mobile gap on 145 pages; Sep 18 Utah coordinates removed from /about/ schema; Sep 21 claims removed from 10 emergency pages.
- Sep 25 to 26: city-swap pages rewritten on researched keywords; Sep 26 hub linking (110 links); Sep 30 image alt audit; Oct 3 striking-distance batch; Oct 7 seven-page crawl boost; Oct 9 three fixture pages rewritten.

# Known data problems
- GA4 gap Sep 4 to 10 (tag sent to Utah property until Sep 12).
- No Core Web Vitals field data. Search Atlas GSC mirror undercounts. Windows crossing Sep 3 to 12 mix relaunch noise. CRM "Value" is not revenue.

# Decisions and status
- Many screenshot checkboxes are still open (browser tooling could not save images on Sep 24); the numbers themselves are captured.
- Phase 4 outline waits on the gate. Never write "before we started" over September figures.
